thread:
lina_support: Customer reports SSE (EventSource) connection drops mid-stream in Safari behind Fastly CDN, stops receiving events after ~8s. ticket 12345, req id abc123.
support-bot: Created support ticket #12345 and attached initial headers.
devin_api: Can you paste their exact client code + server response headers? Safari version?
lina_support: Simple client: `const es = new EventSource('https://api.customer.example.com/v1/events?sid=xyz', { withCredentials: true }); es.onmessage = e => console.log(e.data); es.onerror = () => console.log('es error');`
They use Safari 16.x on macOS 13. Auth via HttpOnly session cookie.
sam_runtime: Edge logs for abc123: initial 200 OK text/event-stream chunked, ~8KB streamed, then origin responds with 304 Not Modified on a revalidation, Fastly serves 304 to edge and client disconnects. Cache-Control on origin: `max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=30`. Vary header only `Accept-Encoding`.
olivia_eng: Safari's EventSource often treats mid-connection non-200/connection resets as terminal. 304 during streaming will cause the browser to close without retry. Also SW + EventSource can be flaky.
devin_api: Actionable server/edge checklist: set `Cache-Control: no-store`/`private` for SSE, ensure origin does not return 304 for streaming endpoints, add `Vary: Authorization` if response depends on auth, disable gzip/transform for streams.
lina_support: Customer refuses full CDN removal; asked for client workaround.
olivia_eng: Client-side mitigations (stopgap):
- Use an EventSource polyfill (XHR/fetch-based) that better handles reconnects in Safari (e.g., Yaffle/EventSource).
- Add `retry: 2000` in SSE messages and periodic comment keepalives `: keepalive

` to keep intermediaries alive.
- Fallback to short-polling when SSE stalls > 10s.
sam_runtime: Also ensure CORS preflight allows credentials and Authorization if used: `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true` and `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization`. If CDN strips Authorization or omits Vary, cached responses leak across sessions.
devin_api: Customer curl output they provided:
````
$ curl -i -H 'Cookie: session=...' 'https://api.customer.example.com/v1/events?sid=xyz'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Cache-Control: max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=30
Vary: Accept-Encoding

# after ~8s
HTTP/1.1 304 Not Modified
````
So origin is enabling fastly revalidation -> root cause.
olivia_eng: Recommended origin response headers to give customer/infra team:
````
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Cache-Control: no-store, must-revalidate
Vary: Authorization
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://app.customer.example.com
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type
````
sam_runtime: I'll open an infra ticket to add a Fastly VCL bypass for paths `/v1/events*`, disable cache and compression/transform. infra-bot: Created INFRA-789 (Fastly: bypass streaming endpoints), assigned to @sam_runtime. ETA ~48h.
lina_support: Customer tested polyfill and saw better continuity but lost auth on reconnects because their cookie was HttpOnly and some polyfills need token in query/header. They can test with `?token=` for debugging only.
devin_api: Long-term fix: CDN bypass + correct cache/CORS headers is required. Short-term: polyfill + token in query or keepalive + server-side credits for excess tokens.
finance-bot: Billing case BILL-456 opened to review credits for token usage during incident window.
sam_runtime: Adding edge logs and replay link to INFRA-789. Will push VCL change to staging for validation: ensure no 304s, confirm `Content-Encoding` unchanged.
lina_support: I'll deliver the header snippet and polyfill notes to customer and ask them to retest once INFRA-789 is merged. Will update ticket #12345. Thanks :thumbsup:
